costNote: What it costs Agilent to build the instruments and deliver the services it sold. It FELL in dollars ($836M vs $850M a year ago) even as revenue rose 8% — the main reason margins expanded.

opex.name: Selling, general & administrative
opex.note: Sales teams, service organization and head-office costs — the biggest running cost.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Developing the next generation of lab instruments and diagnostics.

oneTimers.label: Tariff refunds
oneTimers.text: About $17M of net benefit in the quarter (roughly $0.06 of non-GAAP EPS and ~110bp of non-GAAP operating margin) came from tariff refunds — not from selling more instruments.

segments.name: Agilent CrossLab
segments.note: Services, consumables and informatics attached to labs Agilent has already equipped — the recurring-revenue engine. Grew 6% reported, 5% core.

segments.name: Life Sciences & Diagnostics
segments.note: Instruments and diagnostics for pharma, biotech and clinical labs — the fastest-growing group this quarter. Grew 11% reported, 10% core.

segments.name: Applied Markets
segments.note: Instruments for chemical, energy, food and environmental testing. Grew 7% reported and core.

sources.label: Agilent Q3 FY2026 earnings release — SEC EDGAR Ex-99.1 (8-K, Aug 26, 2026)

takeaways.text: Revenue rose 8.1% to $1.88B while GAAP operating margin widened 290 basis points to 23.6% — costs were essentially flat, so growth dropped through to profit.
takeaways.title: Growth with margin attached

takeaways.text: Non-GAAP EPS of $1.62 included about $0.06 (~$17M) of net tariff-refund benefit, and non-GAAP operating margin got a ~110bp lift. GAAP EPS was $1.28, up 8%.
takeaways.title: Tariff refunds flattered non-GAAP

takeaways.text: Agilent raised FY26 revenue guidance to $7.49–7.51B (up 7.8–8.1%) and non-GAAP EPS to $6.18–6.21, citing continued operational momentum.
takeaways.title: Full-year guidance lifted

verdict: Growth and discipline together: revenue up 8%, GAAP operating margin up nearly 3 points, and guidance raised.
